summary: Iteration 2 production-hardening validation: 16/16 backend hardening pytest cases passed (health, admin bearer auth, docs disabled, CORS allowlist, lead persistence with user_agent capping, honeypot rate-limit rollback, Pydantic v2 validation, fresh-IP rate limit, Mongo indexes). 3/3 frontend smoke tests passed (SEO/OG/Twitter meta, contact bubble + privacy notice, full submit -> success state) AFTER clearing a stale .next cache that was breaking CSS in the preview environment. /robots.txt and /sitemap.xml both 200; sitemap has 11 URLs.

minor.issue: The preview ingress (Cloudflare) overrides the backend's CORS headers and returns 'access-control-allow-origin: *' regardless of Origin. The backend itself enforces the allowlist correctly (verified via localhost:8001) but tests against the public URL cannot validate this because of the proxy. In production behind pivotsafe.com this should work as designed.

Cloudflare prepends its own managed bot policy ('Content-Signal' block) and a duplicate 'User-agent: *' section in front of our static /app/frontend/public/robots.txt content. Our file content (User-agent: *, Disallow: /api/, Disallow: /_next/, Sitemap: ...) IS appended at the end so requirements pass, but the served file is not byte-identical to the source. Acceptable behavior for Cloudflare-managed sites.
Pre-existing iter1 finding still applies — in-process deque, single-process only. Not a regression.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL (initially): /_next/static/css/app/layout.css returned 404 because the dev server was serving stale prerendered HTML from a previous `next build` run. Tailwind utility classes (.fixed, .bg-*, etc.) had ZERO rules at runtime, so the contact bubble lost `position: fixed` and rendered at y=4359 in document flow, the modal overlay had no styling, and the entire site looked broken. Mitigated by clearing /app/frontend/.next and restarting frontend supervisor — after that the bubble computed position is 'fixed' at (1840, 1000) and all flows work. Main agent should ensure: either run `next build && next start` cleanly OR ensure dev cache is wiped before deploying. The HTML response carries x-nextjs-prerender:1 + x-nextjs-cache:HIT which leaks prod prerender assets into a dev runtime.
Pre-existing iter1 nested-button hydration error not retested but still applies.

issues: Looks clean — green check, 'Message sent' heading, hello@pivotsafe.com link styled in brand gold, Close button present. No contrast issues.

action_items: FRONTEND HOSTING: ensure the dev/prod boundary is clean. The currently-deployed `yarn start` script runs `next dev` but the .next/ cache contained stale `next build` output that referenced /_next/static/css/app/layout.css which only exists in production builds. Either (a) make `yarn start` run `next start` against a real build, or (b) ensure deploy wipes .next before `next dev` boots. Already mitigated by clearing .next during this test pass.
Verify production CORS in actual prod domain (preview ingress masks it).
Carry over iter1 action items: nested-button fix in hero.tsx; move rate limiter to Redis/Mongo for production; consider trusting only right-most XFF hop.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py hardening is correct — admin bearer dep is fail-closed (404 when ADMIN_TOKEN unset, 401 on missing/bad bearer), docs/redoc/openapi disabled via FastAPI kwargs, indexes ensured in lifespan with try/except logging, _release_rate_limit pops the bucket slot when honeypot trips (verified: spamming honeypot 6x then submitting legit lead from same IP returns 201 not 429).
CORS allowlist works on the backend (localhost:8001 verified): allowed origin echoed exactly, disallowed origin yields 400 'Disallowed CORS origin' with no ACAO header.
MongoDB indexes verified on contact_leads: idx_lead_id (unique), idx_lead_created_desc, idx_ip_created, idx_email_status — all present.

package.json `start` script is `next dev` — production should use `next start` after `next build`. This is the root cause of the CSS 404 issue.

rca_of_the_issue: RCA for the CSS-404 stale-cache bug: the frontend is started via `yarn start` which package.json maps to `next dev -p 3000 -H 0.0.0.0`. At some earlier point `yarn build` was run (per iter1 notes: 'frontend production build was verified locally'), populating /app/frontend/.next with prerendered HTML referencing prod-style asset paths (/_next/static/css/app/layout.css). When `next dev` later started against the same .next dir, it served the stale prerendered HTML (HTTP responses included `x-nextjs-prerender: 1, x-nextjs-cache: HIT`) but the prod CSS paths were never built in dev mode, so the CSS link 404'd. Result: 0 Tailwind rules at runtime, .fixed didn't apply, contact bubble flowed to bottom of page (y=4359), and clicking it appeared to do nothing visible (modal opened off-screen / unstyled). Mitigation applied: `rm -rf /app/frontend/.next && supervisorctl restart frontend`. Permanent fix recommended: switch `start` script to `next start` after `next build`, or add a pre-start cache-clear hook.
